name: Second Thoughts
description: A send-guard that stays quiet. Credentials, API keys and card numbers are caught by pattern alone -- no key, no network, no AI -- and never reach the wire. Install AI Core as well and it also weighs up anger, drunk-posting and oversharing, but only on a draft a free local check has already flagged. Everything else sends untouched, at full speed.
author: bleelblep
